dependency.name: xlsx
dependency.vendoringReason: pnpm 11.22.0 on Windows fails to enumerate licenses for the direct-URL dependency (ERR_PNPM_MISSING_PACKAGE_INDEX_FILE), even after a frozen reinstall. Keep only the unmodified official ESM, type declarations and full license, bound by hash in a private workspace package. Do not modify vendor files or suppress license/security checks; upstream advisory review remains explicit because workspace source is not a registry audit result.
dependency.scope: Unmodified ESM module, dynamically imported only inside the table export worker. No runtime workbook read/import API, CLI, remote CDN scripts, Excel automation or paid features. Unit tests use candidate read only for round-trip checks; browser exports also have an independent openpyxl/ODF XML verifier.
dependency.advisoryConclusion: 0.20.3 is beyond the published remediation versions for those two advisories. This is not exhaustive vulnerability clearance; the legacy npm 0.18.5 package is not selected. No scanner suppression added.

safety.limits: 50 MiB PDF / 500 pages; current page only; 10,000 text stream items/words; 500 rows, 40 columns, 20,000 cells; 2,000 characters/cell and 1,000,000 total; 8 MiB export; 30-second text-stream deadline and owned export worker; OCR inherits 20 MP / 180 seconds. Correction UI renders at most 50 rows at a time.
safety.cancellation: Generation ownership rejects late file/render/text/OCR/export results; workers terminate on abort, timeout, malformed response and completion. Source documents are destroyed on replacement/unmount. Windows uses existing no-replace file commit.
safety.permissions: COPY checked before rendering extraction preview and again before selectable text or OCR. Table extraction is read-only and does not reuse document-modification locks.
safety.cellAdmission: Explicit literal string or finite numeric cells. No source-derived f/h/l fields. Auto preserves leading zeros, ambiguous dates/separators and over-15-digit values as text. Explicit numeric conventions refuse malformed/over-precision input. Invalid XML control characters/surrogates are refused.
safety.windowsSave: Only new XLSX/ODS MIME/extension cases; 8 MiB, ZIP-header admission, same token/offset/length/cancellation/new-file-only transport. Header check is not a full Office package validator. Full export contents are verified separately using independent test readers. No new shell or filesystem capabilities.
safety.odsPackaging: Library STORED output is repacked with mimetype first/uncompressed/no extra field per ODF package section 3.3. Only the writer's bounded (8 MiB), uncompressed, fixed-entry-name output is admitted; no general uploaded ZIP parser or decompressor. XML payloads remain unchanged. Existing ZIP writer admits only one new fixed internal pathname, META-INF/manifest.xml, under explicit ODS mode; flat/image exports remain strict. Independent verifier checks ZIP CRCs and packaging magic positions.

limitations: Grid suggestions use positioned text and spacing, not a guaranteed semantic table parser; borders are not yet analyzed.
Manual region/row/column guides and cell corrections are required for ambiguous structure. No merged-cell or original-formula recovery, no cross-page inference.
OCR is English/French on image-only unrotated pages. Mixed OCR/text pages and rotated text are refused. OCR confidence is a recognition signal, not a calibrated probability of numeric accuracy.
Existing OCR native parser/model security review remains incomplete; no status promotion is implied.

Latest published installer is unchanged. Updated installed-app Save As and Excel/LibreOffice GUI interoperability still need manual acceptance. Do not publish/push this work until requested manual confirmation.
